description:
Screens a shortlist of up to 15 candidate names in one call: the trademarks on
    file near each name, the companies registered under it, and whether its domains are
    registered. Ranks them fewest conflicts first: by how close the nearest mark is, then
    by companies registered under the name and domains taken, then by how many near marks
    there are. No account needed.

    Optional `classes` (Nice class numbers) make marks filed only in unrelated classes
    weigh less; without them, a mark in any class counts. The Swiss company register and
    the .ch and .com domains are always checked; `countries` ("UK", "SG") adds those
    company registers, and .sg for Singapore.

    Returns, for each name, a trademark verdict on what is on file (none_found, similar,
    close or identical), how many near marks were found, where they are filed and the
    closest three; per country, the companies registered under the same or a similar
    name (name and legal form only); and whether each domain is registered or appears
    unregistered. A source that did not answer says not_checked, never that nothing is
    on file, and names whose trademark screen did not finish are listed under
    not_checked. none_found means none were found, not that the name is free to use, and
    an unregistered domain can be taken at any time: it is a screen, not clearance, and
    a filing from the last few days can be missing.
name: check_names
title: Screen a shortlist of names
